predecessor.requiredInvariant: secretsAndHistoryLazy remains true and the complete v1 file remains byte-for-byte unchanged

audience.scope: one authenticated organization and Vault per request
audience.agentRule: Agent credential delivery and authorization do not consume this stream or its local cache

offlineAccessContext.expiryRule: notAfter is exactly issuedAt plus the duration selected by the authoritative organization policy; disabled requires notAfter == issuedAt and never authorizes disconnected use
offlineAccessContext.integrity: the complete context is received over the authenticated member response and committed inside the authenticated local cache transaction; no field can be replaced or locally extended

deltaResponse.appliedThroughSequence: the highest MemberSequence in the largest fully scanned contiguous journal prefix represented by this page; coalescing may advance over scanned rows only when their newest complete head or tombstone is present
deltaResponse.partialPageRule: when continuationCursor is non-null, appliedThroughSequence is strictly below deltaUpperBound and the cursor is bound to that exact safe-prefix sequence; it never advances over the first unscanned or omitted candidate
deltaResponse.completePageRule: continuationCursor is null only after the fixed deltaUpperBound is exhausted, and then appliedThroughSequence equals deltaUpperBound
deltaResponse.independentBoundaryAuthority: on the initial page deltaUpperBound equals the authoritative Vault.MemberSequence captured after validating request afterSequence against Vault.MinRetainedMemberSequence; continuation pages recover the same upper bound and safe-prefix position from the authenticated cursor

memberSecretPayload.shape: the complete current MemberSecretPayload frozen by v1/registry.json

memberVaultKeyPackage.wrapperContextEncoding: ASCII(PLDNX2W1) || u16be(protocolVersion) || ascii16(wrapperSuiteId) || u16be(purpose) || u16be(scopeBitmap) || present scoped UUIDs in organization-vault-entry-grantOrRequest-agent-member order || u64be(resourceRevision) || u32be(wrappedKeyVersion) || optional-u32(memberKeyGeneration) || u16be(recipientKeyKind) || u32be(recipientKeyVersion) || recipientFingerprint[32] || optional-bytes32(parentDescriptorHash)
memberVaultKeyPackage.independentValidation: the expected wrapper descriptor is built from authenticated request/Vault/Member/key state before opening; the context hash inside the package must match that independent descriptor
memberVaultKeyPackage.openedVaultKeyContinuity: the opened raw Vault key must match the client-side current Vault-key trust anchor when that generation is already established; first installation additionally requires the exact backend-authoritative current MemberVaultKeyEnvelope bytes, never an envelope reconstructed from its own descriptor

requestAuthority: initial delta afterSequence and pageSize or authenticated continuation cursor
clientCryptoAuthority: current raw Vault key already established in memory for the same generation, when present
recipient private key used to authenticate and open the exact authoritative wrapper
requiredEqualities: accessContext.principalId == authenticated principalId
accessContext.organizationId == authenticated organizationId
accessContext.organizationMembershipGeneration == current organization membership generation
accessContext.vaultId == route vaultId
accessContext.memberId == current structural Vault member and authenticated principalId
accessContext.memberKeyGeneration == authoritative Vault memberKeyGeneration
accessContext.vaultKeyVersion == authoritative current Vault key version
accessContext.memberRecipientKeyVersion/memberRecipientKeyFingerprint == authoritative current Member X25519 key binding
accessContext.offlinePolicy/offlinePolicyVersion == authoritative organization policy
memberVaultKey scope organizationId/vaultId/memberId == request and access context
memberVaultKey memberKeyGeneration/vaultKeyVersion == access context
memberVaultKey recipient key version/fingerprint == access context and authoritative current Member X25519 key binding
memberVaultKey exact envelope bytes == backend-authoritative current MemberVaultKeyEnvelope; opened raw key == existing client-side same-generation Vault-key trust anchor when present
every head entryId/kind/state/updatedAt/currentRevision/memberIndexRevision/currentKeyVersion == the independently loaded authoritative Entry head
every Entry envelope scope organizationId/vaultId/entryId == request and authoritative head
memberSecret resourceRevision == head currentRevision
memberIndex resourceRevision == head memberIndexRevision
memberIndexRevision == currentRevision
entryKey keyVersion == head currentKeyVersion
memberIndex and memberSecret keyVersion == head currentKeyVersion
entryKey, memberIndex and memberSecret memberKeyGeneration == access context memberKeyGeneration
entryKey wrappingVaultKeyVersion == access context vaultKeyVersion
delta request afterSequence >= authoritative MinRetainedMemberSequence or the response is resetRequired
initial deltaUpperBound == authoritative Vault.MemberSequence captured for the page; continuation deltaUpperBound == the authenticated cursor boundary
appliedThroughSequence stays between request/cursor safe-prefix position and deltaUpperBound
independentAuthority.forbiddenAuthority: an expected organization, Vault, principal, Member, Entry, revision, key version, generation, policy or expiry value must never be copied from the same envelope or access context being validated

sequenceSemantics.snapshotBase: Vault current MemberSequence captured before the first page
sequenceSemantics.concurrentMutation: visible exactly once in the snapshot winner or closing delta
sequenceSemantics.deltaUpperBound: Vault current MemberSequence captured on the first delta page and stable through continuation
sequenceSemantics.deltaCoalescing: newest complete current head or tombstone for every affected Entry in the largest safe contiguous prefix
sequenceSemantics.appliedThroughSequence: highest MemberSequence in that fully scanned safe contiguous prefix; below deltaUpperBound while continuation remains and equal to deltaUpperBound only after exhaustion
sequenceSemantics.continuationCursor: authenticated cursor bound to the same appliedThroughSequence; a retry resumes strictly after it without skipping the first omitted candidate
sequenceSemantics.duplicateApply: idempotent by stream generation and monotonic authoritative projection revisions

pagination.responseByteMeasurement: UTF-8 JSON bytes before transport encoding

resetAndLifecycle.resetCondition: afterSequence < MinRetainedMemberSequence or an authoritative membership/key/policy generation cannot continue safely
resetAndLifecycle.snapshotRebuild: new authenticated ciphertext cache namespace followed by one atomic swap after the closing delta
resetAndLifecycle.resetPrecedence: invalidate and delete the affected active generation before staging a replacement
resetAndLifecycle.tombstonePrecedence: a newer tombstone cannot be undone by a delayed head or duplicate page

mutations.import: one complete head per committed Entry
mutations.archive: complete non-active head or the existing lifecycle-defined tombstone
mutations.restore: complete head at the new current revision
mutations.delete: existing lifecycle-defined non-active head or tombstone
mutations.agentVisibilityPolicyChange: complete head with the complete MemberSecret
mutations.entryDekRotation: complete head at the new key version
mutations.membershipRemoval: access denial or reset without ciphertext disclosure

offlineAccess.leaseRenewalChannel: snapshot, delta or authoritative repair only
offlineAccess.alreadyOfflineTightening: the client retains no authority beyond the earlier notAfter in its last valid context
offlineAccess.connectedRevocation: policy disablement, access denial, membership removal, tombstone, reset and logout purge the affected material immediately
offlineAccess.leaseExpiry: clear decrypted memory, delete the affected current ciphertext generation and require authoritative resynchronization
offlineAccess.lock: clear plaintext and every raw key from memory; an unexpired authenticated ciphertext generation may remain
offlineAccess.logout: delete the whole local profile, cache, cursors, access context and native AutoFill derivative

allowed: authenticated cursors and finite offline access context
KDF parameters and encrypted private-key blobs required by the reviewed local unlock path
forbidden: TOTP seed outside the selected in-memory operation
localStorage.mobileNativeException: a dedicated non-exportable OS-protected cache key requiring user presence may wrap the native ciphertext cache; it is not MK, the user private key, VK or EntryDEK
localStorage.quotaFailure: reject the new generation without partial activation

performance.backendQueryCount: bounded by page construction and independent of Entry count; no per-Entry or per-projection query
